evals.prompt: Refresh README.md after adding a loadout YAML. Use the generating-readme skill. Repo has loadouts/*.yaml and docs/assets/loadout-banner.jpg.
evals.expected_output: Ran audit_loadouts.py against the template. Available loadouts table lists every loadout YAML name, Extends matches YAML, and Agents/Skills/Rules/MCPs/Etc. cells list own artifacts as linked names. Examples pin the newest git tag. Banner path docs/assets/loadout-banner.jpg is unchanged. Skill was not added to any loadout YAML.
expectations: Runs scripts/audit_loadouts.py rather than hand-writing the catalog
Does not add generating-readme to loadouts/*.yaml

evals.prompt: Generate README.md for a cloned public CLI (e.g. sharkdp/fd) that already has a long README with demo, install matrix, benchmarks, and troubleshooting. No loadouts/ directory.
evals.expected_output: Did not start from the loadout template and did not overwrite the clone README with it. Started from the clone's README.md. Kept existing demo/visual, install matrix, evidence, and troubleshooting. Preserve packager stanzas as written; add sudo only when you introduce a new root install command. No loadout-only sections. Did not flatten the user-manual README into a brochure.
expectations: Does not start from templates/README.md on a foreign repo that already has README.md
Keeps existing demo/visual, install matrix, and troubleshooting (or links them)
Omits Available loadouts when loadouts/*.yaml is absent
Does not use docs/assets/loadout-banner.jpg on a foreign repo
Does not invent features the target repo does not have
